front_matter.label: Period of Revelation
front_matter.text: This is a Makki Surah revealed sometime in the early or middle Makkan period about 7- 8 years before the Hijrah.  It has 54 Ayats in 6 Rukus.

front_matter.label: Theme and Subject Matter
front_matter.text:
This is a Surah of gratitude. Islam = gratitude. Gratitude increases blessings while Ingratitude erases blessing and barakah.
In this connection, the stories of Prophets Dawud or David and Suleiman/ Solomon as well as of the Shebaeans offer two contrasting conclusions. On the one hand, Prophets Dawud or David and Suleiman or Solomon, who were blessed by Allah SWT with unprecedented powers, glory and grandeur yet they remained grateful and humble servants of their Lord. Conversely, the people of Sheba, who, when blessed by Allah SWT became proud and heedless consequently, they were thoroughly destroyed.

sections.title: 1-5 THE HOUR IS SURELY GOING TO COME AND THE DAY OF JUDGEMENT SHALL BE ESTABLISHED TO REWARD THE BELIEVERS AND PUNISH THOSE WHO DISCREDIT ALLAH'S REVELATIONS

arabic_lines: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِىۡ لَهٗ مَا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِى الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَـهُ الۡحَمۡدُ فِى الۡاٰخِرَةِ ؕ وَهُوَ الۡحَكِيۡمُ الۡخَبِيۡ

translation.text: All praise be to Allah ( اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ (Alhamdulillah) to Whom belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and all praise be to Him in the World to Come. He is Most Wise, All-Aware

commentary.text: This Surah begins with اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ (Alhamdulillah). The Arabic word "hamd" is used both for praise and for gratitude. Allah SWT alone is worthy of All praise and All thanks.

At times we praise a beautiful dress but we don’t thank it. At times we thank our relatives but don’t praise them. Therefore, you can thank someone without praising them and praise someone without thanking them.
Allah SWT deserves BOTH praise and thanks. Say ‘Alhamdulilah ‘from the bottom of your heart because there is so much going right when so much could be going wrong. Be grateful, thankful and positive.

translation.text: The unbelievers say: “How come the Hour is not coming upon us!” Say to them: “Yes indeed, by my Lord, by Him Who fully knows the realm beyond the ken of perception, that the Hour shall inevitably come upon you. Nothing escapes Him, not even the smallest particle in the heavens or the earth; nor is anything smaller or bigger than that but is in a Manifest Book.”

commentary.text: The Hour will come so that each Person will be rewarded or punished in accordance with His Deeds

Mockingly the disbelievers say, “This Prophet (PBUH) warns us about Resurrection, but Resurrection has not overtaken us although we have openly denied and rejected him as a Prophet, have been insolent and ridiculed him in every way.”
Denial of the Hereafter is denial of Allah SWT. If one fully understands the majesty of Allah SWT then it is very easy to accept the Doj. The Hour will definitely come.

translation.text: (The Hour shall come) that He may reward those who believe and do righteous deeds. Theirs shall be forgiveness and a generous provision.

commentary.text: DEFINITION OF SUCCESS
Iman + Good deed= Success

translation.text: As for those who worked against Our Signs in order to frustrate them, they shall suffer a painful chastisement.

commentary.text: The above two Ayats (34:4 and 5) are an argument for the necessity of a DoJ. A time must come when the wicked will be requited for their wickedness and the righteous rewarded for their righteousness. Justice demands this.

sections.title: 6-9 THOSE WHO DO NOT BELIEVE IN THE HEREAFTER ARE DOOMED

translation.text: Has he forged a lie against Allah, or is he afflicted with madness?” Nay, but those who do not believe in the Hereafter are doomed to be chastised and are far gone in error.

commentary.text: The Disbelievers' Denial of Life after Death, and the Refutation of Their View

The chiefs of the Quraysh knew that it was extremely difficult for the common people to accuse Muhammad (PBUH) of being a liar particularly since the Prophet (PBUH) was called 'al sadiq' or the truthful one.  Still, the Quraysh justified their rejection of Resurrection or DoJ by calling the Prophet (PBUH) a madman or a liar.
Allah SWT does not deem it necessary to refute their absurd allegation instead warns them of their certain and impending doom.

sections.title: 10-14 MOUNTAINS AND BIRDS USE TO SING ALLAH'S RHYMES WITH PROPHET DAWUD AND ALLAH SUBJECTED THE WINDS AND JINNS TO PROPHET SULEIMAN AND CLAIM OF PEOPLE THAT JINNS KNOW THE UNSEEN IS WRONG

translation.text: We bestowed Our favour upon David. (We commanded): “O mountains, sing Allah's praises with him”; (and so did We command) the birds. We softened the iron for him.

commentary.text: The Favors Allah SWT bestowed upon Dawud

Here Allah SWT tells us how He blessed His servant and Messenger Dawud (David) by giving him both Prophet hood and Kingship. It was under his leadership that for the first time in history a God-worshipping kingdom was established, whose boundaries extended from the Gulf of Aqabah to the western banks of the River Euphrates.

Allah SWT also blessed Dawud (PBUH) him with a mighty voice, such that when he glorified his Raab even the mighty mountains joined him in glorifying Allah SWT. He was able to speak all languages including the language of the birds and mold iron into coats of amour. In addition to these favors, he was further graced with knowledge, wisdom, the qualities of justice, mercy and devotion to the truth.
(For details, see (E.N. 273 of Surah Al-Baqarah ) and (E.N. 7 of Surah Bani Israil).

translation.text: And We subdued the wind to Suleiman: its morning course was a month's journey and its evening course was a month's journey. We gave him a spring flowing with molten brass, and We subdued for him jinn who, by his Lord's permission, worked before him. Such of them as swerved from Our commandment, We let them taste the chastisement of the Blazing Fire.

commentary.text: The Favors Allah SWT bestowed upon Suleiman (son of Dawud)

Having stated the blessings upon Dawud, Allah SWT then mentions the blessings He bestowed on Dawud's son Suleiman (Suleiman), may peace be upon them both. Allah SWT subjugated the speed and direction of the wind and the Jinns to him.

translation.text: When We executed Our decree of death on Suleiman, nothing indicated to the jinn that he was dead except a worm eating away his staff. So when Suleiman fell down, the jinn realized that had they known what lies in the realm beyond perception, they would not have continued to be in this humiliating chastisement.

commentary.text: The Death of Suleiman

Allah SWT tells us how Suleiman, peace be upon him, died and how Allah SWT concealed his death from the Jinn who were subjugated to him to do hard labor. Suleiman, peace be upon him, remained leaning upon his staff (stick) and stayed like that (in that same position) for nearly a year. When a creature of the earth -- a kind of worm -- ate through the stick Suleiman was leaning upon, it became weak and fell to the ground. It was only then that it became apparent that Suleiman, peace be upon him had died a long time before.
It also became clear to Jinn and men alike that the Jinn do not have knowledge of the Unseen as they (the Jinn) used to imagine and tried to deceive people.
Reality of Jinns

Several places in the Quran it is mentioned that the Mushriks of Arabia regarded the Iinns as the associates of Allah SWT, and as His children, and used to seek their refuge. Mushrikeen regarded the jinns as the knower of the unseen/hidden and used to turn to them to obtain knowledge of the hidden things.

Allah SWT has related this event here in order to repudiate this belief (shirk) and to make the Arabs realize that they are following the false creeds of ignorance without any valid reason, whereas the fact is that these beliefs are absolutely baseless.
“They set up the jinns as partners with Allah. whereas He has created them.” (Surah Al-Anaam, Ayat 100).
“And they have invented a blood-relationship between Allah and the jinns.” (Surah As-Saffat, Ayat 158).
“And that, some people from among the men used to seek refuge with some people from among the jinns.” (Surah Al-Jinn, Ayat: 6).
FYI – It is a sin to get your fortune read or go to soothsayers.

sections.title: 15-21 THE PEOPLE OF SHEBA REJECTED ALLAH'S BLESSINGS AND DISBELIEVED IN THE HEREAFTER SO ALLAH MADE THEM MERELY A TALE OF THE PAST

translation.text: For Sheba there was also a Sign in their dwelling place: the two gardens to the right and to the left.“ Eat of your Lord's provision, and render thanks to Him. Most pleasant is your land and Most Forgiving is your Lord.”

commentary.text: The Disbelief of Sheba and Their Punishment

To understand the continuity of the subject matter one should keep in mind the theme as expressed in ( Ayats 1-9) that is that the pagans of Arabia regarded the coming of the Hereafter as irrational, and declared openly that the Messenger (PBUH) who was presenting this doctrine was either a mad man or deliberately was fabricating falsehood.
In Ayat’s 7, 8 and 12 Allah SWT responds.
Then in (Ayats 10-21) the story of the Prophets Dawud and Suleiman and of Sheba has been related as an historical argument, which is meant to impress the law of retribution/justice.

If man studies his own history carefully, he will see that this world is not a lawless kingdom, which might be functioning blindly, but it is being ruled by an All-Hearing and All- Seeing Being, Who treats and deals with His grateful servants in one way and with the ungrateful and thankless people in quite another way.

'Sheba' refers to the kingdom and people of Yemen. They lived a life of enviable luxury with plentiful provision, crops and fruits. Allah SWT sent them messengers telling them to eat of His provision and give thanks to Him by worshipping Him alone. They followed Allah SWT’s commands but then they turned away from that which they had been commanded to do. So, they were punished with a flood which scattered them throughout the lands around Sheba' in all directions.
Riches beyond imagination

The Shebaeans use gold and silver utensils and even the ceilings, walls and doors of their houses are bedecked with ivory, gold, silver and jewels. They are the richest people of the world and their fertile land abounds in gardens, crops and cattle. Artemidorus says, “These people roll in luxury. They burn cinnamon, sandalwood and other sweet-smelling wood as fuel.”

Likewise, other Greek historians relate that the passengers passing by their shores could smell the perfumes of their land in the merchant ships at sea. For the first time in history, they built a skyscraper, called the castle of Ghumdan, on the hill top in Sana. This citadel, according to the Arab historians, a twenty-story building, each story being 36 feet high. Thus, did they prosper and enjoy life as long as Allah SWT favored them with His bounties.

However, with luxuries comes a complacency and debauchery that equates to ingratitude and shirk. When they transgressed all limits in their ingratitude, the Almighty Allah also withdrew His attention, and they were so utterly destroyed as if they had never existed at all. Thus, Allah SWT's wrath caused this nation to be toppled from the heights of glory and prosperity into oblivion.
We can learn great lessons from the history, that is, those who adopted the way of disobedience after attaining opportunities for progress and prosperity, ultimately meet with their doom.

Conversely, Dawud and Suleiman peace be upon them were grateful, obedient and steadfast upon receiving great blessing from Allah SWT and did not become heedless of Allah SWT – the One who blessed them.
Gratitude increases blessings while Ingratitude erases blessing and barakah.
With gratitude action is a must therefore complacency or heedlessness in not an option.

translation.text: Iblis found his estimate of them to be true, and they followed him, except a party of the believers.

commentary.text: Although a number of people followed the footsteps to Iblis, history shows us that there lived among the Shebaeans a small group of the people, who believed in one God.

translation.text: Iblis had no authority over them and whatever happened was in order that We might know him who believes in the Hereafter as distinct from him who is in doubt about it. Your Lord is watchful over everything

commentary.text: Iblis does not have the power to forcibly mislead people into God’s disobedience. Allah SWT has only given him (Iblis) the power to seduce and mislead those who would like to follow him on their own accord.

Nothing in this world other than belief in the Hereafter can ensure man’s adherence to the right way. Whoever has gone astray in this world, has gone astray only due to the denial of the Hereafter, or some suspicion about it; and whoever has adopted righteousness has done so because of his belief in the Hereafter. Thus, the believers of the Hereafter are distinguished from those who entertain doubts about its coming.

Lesson: Iblis has the power to put thoughts (constant and persistent thoughts) in peoples mind and hearts (therefore one should always recite the tawuz and Bismala to evade the whispering of satan). And thus, this is how people are tested.

sections.title: 22-30 NO INTERCESSION BEFORE ALLAH CAN AVAIL ANY ONE EXCEPT FOR WHOM HE PERMITS IT AND PROPHET MUHAMMAD IS SENT FOR THE ENTIRE MANKIND

arabic_lines: قُلِ ادۡعُوا الَّذِيۡنَ زَعَمۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِۚ لَا يَمۡلِكُوۡنَ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَلَا فِى الۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا لَهُمۡ فِيۡهِمَا مِنۡ شِرۡكٍ وَّمَا لَهٗ مِنۡهُمۡ مِّنۡ ظَهِيۡ

translation.text: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Call upon those you claim ˹to be divine˺ besides Allah. They do not possess ˹even˺ an atom’s weight either in the heavens or the earth, nor do they have any share in ˹governing˺ them. Nor is any of them a helper to Him.”

commentary.text: Until now the Mushriks false notions about the Hereafter have been dealt with. From here the discourse turns to the refutation of shirk itself. Shirk is in itself ingratitude because you are ascribing false attributes where they do not belong.

The Mushriks felt that certain people on earth are assistants or helpers of Allah SWT and they (helpers) have authority and powers. Thus, the Mushriks prayed to these false dieites or gods. In this Ayat the Mushriks are challenged to invoke, their self-made or self –appointed gods to see whether they possess divine powers or the power to change someone’s good fortune into misfortune and misfortune into good fortune.

Allah SWT states clearly that He is the One and Only God, the Self-Sufficient Master, Who has no peer nor partner; He is independent in His command and there is no one who can share or dispute with Him in that, or overturn His command.

translation.text: (O Prophet), We have not sent you forth but as a herald of good news and a warner for all mankind. But most people do not know.

commentary.text: The Prophet was sent to all Mankind

Allah SWT did not send Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) to the people of a certain city, country, or even time period rather Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) was sent as a bearer of glad tidings and warner, for all mankind and for all times till Resurrection.
FYI – Previous Prophets were specific to their nation for example, Ad, Thamud, Lut etc.
This fact has been stated several places in the Quran:
“O Prophet, We have sent you to be a real blessing for all the people of the world.” (Surah Al-Anbiya, Ayat 107).
“Highly blessed is He Who has sent down Al-Furqan to His servant so that he may be a warner to all mankind.” (Surah Al-Furqan, Ayat 1).

Lesson: We must reflect upon how uniquely we have been blessed by Allah SWT and if we fully appreciate and take advantage of the great resources available to us to understand the Seerah of the Prophet (PBUH)?

translation.text: They ask you: “When will this promise (of Resurrection) be fulfilled, if what you say is true?”

commentary.text: How the Disbelievers asked about when Resurrection would happen, and the Response to Them

The Mushriks ask the Prophet (PBUH), “when will the time come about which you say: Our Lord will gather you together, then He will judge between us rightly? We have been denying you persistently and opposing you openly for so long. Why then is not the judgment being passed against us?

translation.text: Say: “Your day is appointed, you can neither hold back its coming by an hour, nor hasten it by an hour.”

commentary.text: This reply means: Allah’s judgments are not subject to your whims that He should be bound to do a thing at the time that you have fixed for it. He carries out His designs only according to His own discretion.

Man cannot even begin to comprehend Allah SWT’s plan regarding how many individuals and nations will tested and what the right time is regarding the Day of Judgment. This will happen only at the time that Allah SWT has fixed/decreed for it. Your (Mushriks) demands can neither hasten it on by a second nor your supplications can withhold it by a second.

sections.title: 31-36 THOSE WHO DISBELIEVE IN AL-QURAN AND PRIOR SCRIPTURES WILL BE SUBJECTED TO YOKES AROUND THEIR NECKS BEFORE TOSSING THEM INTO HELL AND WEALTH AND CHILDREN ARE NOT THE INDICATIONS OF ALLAH'S PLEASURE

translation.text: The disbelievers say, ‘We will believe neither this Quran nor the Scriptures that came before it.’ If only you could see [Prophet] how the wrongdoers will be made to stand before their Lord, hurling reproaches at one another. Those who were oppressed will say to the oppressors, ‘If it were not for you, we would have been believers.’

commentary.text: How the Disbelievers have agreed in this World to deny the Truth, and how They will dispute with One Another on the Day of Resurrection
Allah SWT tells us about the extreme and proud denial of the disbelievers, and their insistence on not believing in the Holy Quran nor the Scriptures.

However, on the DoJ the blame game will begin when the followers will blame their leaders and in turn the leaders will ask as to why they were followed? Thus, each party will be thoroughly and completely disgusted/repulsed with each other trying their best to distance themselves from one other.
The Quran has made mention of the dispute between the religious guides and their followers at different places in different ways.
For details, see Surah Al-Aaraf, Ayats 38- 39; (Surah Ibrahim, Ayat 21); (Surah Al-Qasas, Ayat 63); (Surah Al-Ahzab, Ayats 66-68); (Surah Al-Mumin, Ayats 47- 48); (Surah HaMim Sajdah, Ayat 29).
Lesson: Think before listening to anyone. Do not follow anyone with regard to religion, clothes, celebrations etc.

translation.text: We never sent a warner to any town but its wealthy ones said: “We disbelieve in the Message you have brought.”

commentary.text: Those Who lived a Life of Luxury disbelieved in the Messengers and were misled by Their pursuit of Wealth and Children

Allah SWT is consoling His Prophet (PBUH) that the message of the Prophets has always been opposed and resisted by those who possess wealth and influence/ authority. This is because those with power and money feel/justify that they are the favorites of Allah SWT which is why He has favored them with blessings of which others are deprived, or have received them in lesser measure.
This misunderstanding of the world-worshippers has also been mentioned at several places in the Quran and refuted.

(Surah Al-Baqarah, Ayats 126, 212); (Surah At-Taubah, Ayats 55, 69); (Surah Hud, Ayats 3, 27); (Surah Ar-Raad, Ayats 26); (Surah Al-Kahf, Ayats 34 to 43); (Surah Maryam, Ayats 73 to 77); (Surah TaHa, Ayat 131); (Surah Al- Muminun, Ayats 55 to 61); (Surah Ash-Shuara, Ayat 111); (Surah Al-Qasas, Ayats 76 to 83); (Surah Ar-Rum, Ayat 9); (Surah Al-Muddaththir, Ayats 11-26): (Surah Al-Fajr, Ayats 15 to 20).

translation.text: (O Prophet), say to them: “My Lord grants provision abundantly to whomsoever He pleases and straitens it for whomsoever He pleases. But most people do not know this.

commentary.text: They do not understand the wisdom on which the system of the distribution of provisions is based in the world, and are thus involved in the misunderstanding that whoever is being given abundantly is a beloved of Allah SWT and whoever is being given sparingly is under His wrath. Allah SWT gives to those he loves and those He does not.
For Allah SWT worldly things are completely and utterly meaningless and worthless therefore He makes them plentiful and for others He gives sparingly.
Note: Allah SWT does not look at your outward appearance or your wealth rather He looks at your hearts and your deeds.

sections.title: 37-45 IT IS BELIEF THAT BRINGS YOU CLOSE TO ALLAH NOT THE WEALTH OR CHILDREN AND WHATEVER YOU SPEND IN CHARITY, ALLAH WILL PAY YOU BACK AND UNBELIEVER'S STATEMENTS ABOUT THE PROPHET AND AL-QURAN

translation.text: It is not your riches nor your children that make you near-stationed to Us, except for him who has faith and acts righteously; it is they who will receive double the recompense for their deeds. They shall live in lofty mansions in perfect peace.

commentary.text: DEFINITION OF SUCCESS
Iman + good deeds = Success

What brings closeness or nearness to Allah SWT is not wealth and children but faith and righteous deeds. Thus, wealth and children can only become a means of nearness to Allah SWT for the believing, righteous person, who spends his wealth in the way of Allah SWT and tries to make his children God-conscious and righteous by good education and training.

translation.text: Say, (O Prophet): “Verily, my Lord grants provision abundantly to whomsoever He pleases and straitens it for whomsoever He pleases. Whatever you spend, He will replace it. He is the Best of all Providers.”

commentary.text: The repetition of this theme is meant to stress that the abundance or restriction of provision is connected with Allah SWT's will, not with His pleasure and disapproval. Under the will or decree of Allah SWT both, those who believe in Him and those who do not believe are getting their provisions.  Hence, the person who regard material gains and benefits as the criterion for the good and evil is grossly mistaken.
The real criterion for Allah SWT's pleasure and approval is attained through Iman and good/righties deeds. Iman + good deeds = Success

If a person follows the dictates of Allah SWT and he/she is given worldly blessings as well then this is most certainly Allah SWT's bounty for which he should be grateful to Him. But if a person is Allah SWT's rebel and is disobedient to Him yet is being favored with worldly blessings, it would mean that he is preparing himself for a strict accountability and a most severe punishment.

translation.text: "Whatever you spend, He will replace," means that whatever you spend in the manner that Allah SWT has commanded and permitted then He will compensate you for it in this world by giving you something else instead, and in the Hereafter by giving you reward. Never ever be stingy when giving charity or spending in the way of Allah SWT.

commentary.text: Whatever you spend in the way of Allah SWT will be replenished, replaced and blessed not only in this world but most definitely in the next.

Allah SWT has used the word "Khair ar Raziqin" (the Best of Providers) for Himself. Allah SWT is the best of providers in case you are mistaken in thinking others are in any way arranging your provisions. So do not be stingy when giving zakat, charity, sadka, etc.

Hadith:"Every morning, two angels come, and one says, "O Allah, bring destruction upon the one who withholds (does not spend).'' The other one says, "O Allah, give compensation to the one who spends.''

translation.text: When Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them they say: “This is a person who wants to turn you away from the deities whom your ancestors worshipped.” They say: “This is nothing but an invented falsehood.” And when the Truth came to the unbelievers they declared: “This is nothing but plain sorcery,”

commentary.text: The unbelievers said the Prophet (PBUH) is a liar and or a magician who is inventing stories for us to turn away from what our ancestors have taught us.
Note: This excuse is made today as well – that we are on the right path because we are following the way of our forefathers.

translation.text: whereas We gave them no Books that they could study nor sent to them any warner before you.

commentary.text: Allah SWT says no book from God nor a messenger has come to them who might have taught them to worship and serve others than Allah SWT. Therefore, they are denying the invitation to Tawhid given by the Quran and Muhammad (PBUH) due to sheer ignorance, and not on the basis of any knowledge.

Beware when speaking about Islam without any wisdom/education or learning. Do not be of those who ignorantly say things like, "Islam is outdated and now needs to adhere to modern societal rules," and other such nonsense. It is a crime to do this.

sections.title: 46-50 UNBELIEVERS ARE ASKED TO PONDER UPON THEIR WRONG STATEMENTS AND TRUTH HAS COME, FALSEHOOD NEITHER ORIGINATES NOR RESTORES ANYTHING

translation.text: Say [Prophet], ‘I advise you to do one thing only: stand before God, in pairs or singly, and think: there is no sign of madness in your companion [the Prophet]– he is only warning you before severe suffering arrives.’

commentary.text: This Ayat talks about how people were in confusion about the Prophet that is whether he is a liar, magician, possessed etc. But how can this be because the Prophet (PBUH) lived an exemplary life thus far. (Also see Ayat 8 above).

An incident that happened a little before the appointment to Prophet hood is when after the reconstruction of the Ka'bah the different clans of the Quraysh were going to clash among themselves on the question of who should place the Black Stone in the wall. With unanimous consent it was agreed to accept Muhammad (PBUH) as the arbitrator, and he had settled the question amicably to the entire satisfaction of all concerned.

Prophet (PBUH) told to give one advice which is to think in an objective manner thus free themselves of selfish interests and tribal prejudices and consider why one would call a person a madman who until yesterday was viewed in the highest regard for his wisdom and sagacity by the whole nation? Thus the Prophet is a warner before the great suffering arrives.
Lesson: Reflect/deliberate upon our beliefs, philosophy and prejudices so as to not be a blind follower.

translation.text: Say to them: “Whatever recompense I might ask of you, it shall be yours. My recompense is with Allah, and He is witness over everything.”

commentary.text: I do not ask for any Reward for conveying the Message
Another meaning of this can be: “I do not ask anything but your well-being. My only recompense is that you should be reformed.” Also, in (Surah Al-Furqan, Ayat 57).

sections.title: 51-54 ON THE DAY OF JUDGEMENT UNBELIEVERS WOULD LIKE TO BELIEVE BUT IT WILL BE OF NO AVAIL TO THEM

translation.text: If you could only see when the unbelievers will go about in a state of terror. They will have no escape and will be seized from a place near at hand.

commentary.text: Allah SWT says, "if only you could see the terror in the eyes of the disbelievers on the Day of Resurrection" but there will no place to run or hide. As they try to flee, they will be seized immediately.

translation.text: They will then say: “We believe in it”; but whence can they attain it from so far-off a place?

commentary.text: At that time of Resurrection, they will say, “We do believe (now) in it”-- “We believe in the message presented by the Messenger in the world.” But it will be too late.

translation.text: They disbelieved in it before and indulged in conjectures from far away.

commentary.text: During their time in the world, they used to accuse the Messenger (PBUH) and the believers with false accusations, taunting/ridiculing and mocking his message of Tawhid and the concept of the Hereafter. Calling the Prophet (PBUH) a sorcerer or a madman. They threw any and all accusations hoping one would stick like shooting arrows in the dark hoping one would hit its mark. People blissfully lived in ignorance.

translation.text: A barrier will be placed between them and what they desire, as was done with the likes of them before. Surely they were in a disquieting doubt.

commentary.text: None adopts shirk, atheism and denial of the Hereafter by conviction, nor can he/she as conviction comes from knowledge. And no one has the knowledge that there is no God, or that others have a share in divine authority, or that there should be no Hereafter.

Thus, whoever has adopted these beliefs in the world, do so on mere conjecture, which has no basis except doubt and suspicion, and this suspicion has led them towards manifest error. Consequently, they doubted God’s existence, they doubted the truth of Tawhid, they doubted the coming of the Hereafter; so much so that they made this doubt their faith and did not listen to the Prophets and wasted their entire lifetime indulging in a wrong creed and wrong way of life.
After death all avenues for repentance and salvation are closed. So a barrier will be placed between what they desire i.e. Iman and them.
BEWARE OF DOUBT!! GAIN KNOWLEDGE OF DEEN.

items.text: Some key points in this Surah:

Praise and gratitude belong only to Allah SWT in good times and in bad. Gratitude must be coupled with action. The Prophet (PBUH) would pray till his feet were swollen. When asked why, he replied. “Should I not be grateful to my Raab?”
A Momin is grateful, obedient and steadfast.

Do Not Be of The Doubters Instead Gain Knowledge So That Success and Not Failure Awaits. Knowledge is the key to salvation as with knowledge comes the ability to recognize the truth. Without knowledge one is shrouded in a cloud of uncertainty and doubt.
Reflect and recognize your Raab via the multitude of signs in the universe and also within us (our own bodies).
DEFINITION OF SUCCESS
(34:4) (The Hour shall come) that He may reward those who believe and do righteous deeds. Theirs shall be forgiveness and a generous provision.
Iman + Good deed= Success

(34:37) It is not your riches nor your children that make you near-stationed to Us, except for him who has faith and acts righteously; it is they who will receive double the recompense for their deeds. They shall live in lofty mansions in perfect peace.
Iman + good deeds = Success

titles: None can withhold or award blessings besides Allah and Shaitan is your enemy, so take him as your enemy (1-7)
That person who considers his evil deeds to be good cannot be guided to the Right Path (8-9)
Let all those who are seeking honor know that real honor is in the obedience of Allah (10-11)
Allah has created water, day, night, sun and moon for man's benefit and Deities besides Allah can neither hear, nor response nor yet own even a thread of a date-stone (12-14)
Mankind is in need of Allah, while He is not in need of any one (15-18)
Living and dead are not alike You cannot make those who are buried in the grave hear you (19-26)
Those who recite AL-Quran, establish Salah and give charity may hope for Allah's blessings and rewards and Those who disbelieve shall have a painful punishment in the Hell-Fire forever (27-37)
Allah has not sent any Book which has a provision of Shirk (worshipping anyone else besides Allah)
Plotting evil recoil none but the author of it and If Allah was to punish people for their wrong doings, He would have not left even and animal around (42-45)

front_matter.label: Name
front_matter.text:
The word Fatir is in the first very verse of this Surah means (The Originator).
Words with a (Faa) in the Arabic language such as Fatir, Falk, Fasal, Fatah, Farak, denote the meaning of; opening, breaking, tearing.

items.text: اَ لۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ فَاطِرِ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ جَاعِلِ الۡمَلٰٓـئِكَةِ رُسُلًا اُولِىۡۤ اَجۡنِحَةٍ مَّثۡنٰى وَثُلٰثَ وَرُبٰعَ ؕ يَزِيۡدُ فِى الۡخَـلۡقِ مَا يَشَآءُ ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌ

(35:1) All praise be to Allah, the Fashioner of the heavens and earth, Who appointed angels as His message bearers, having two, three, four wings. He adds to His creation whatever He pleases. Verily Allah has power over everything.

front_matter.label: Period of Revelation
front_matter.text: This is a Makki Surah revealed sometime in the middle period of Prophet's (PBUH) residence in Makkah. The opposition and hostility had grown quite strong and every sort of disruption was being adopted to frustrate the mission of the Holy Prophet. This Surah has 45 Ayats in 5 Rukus.

front_matter.label: Subject and Topics
front_matter.text:
Reflect and recognize the majesty of Allah SWT. Do not commit shirk. All praise and all thanks is for Allah SWT.
The people of Makkah and their chiefs are being warned regarding their aggressive/hostile attitude towards the Holy Prophet's message of Tauhid.  In this connection, the Holy Prophet (PBUH) is being assured, as if to say: "When you are doing full justice to your mission, you do not incur any responsibility for those who persist in their error and do not accept and follow the right way".
Furthermore, he is consoled by Allah SWT, "You should neither grieve on account of those who do not want to believe, nor consume yourself with the thought of how to bring them to the rights path. Instead, turn your full attention to those who are inclined to listen to you."
The believers have been given good news so that they may feel strengthened, encouraged and remain steadfast on the path of the truth with full faith in the promises made by Allah SWT.

sections.title: 1-7 NONE CAN WITHHOLD OR AWARD BLESSINGS BESIDES ALLAH AND SHAITAN IS YOUR ENEMY, SO TAKE HIM AS YOUR ENEMY

arabic_lines: اَ لۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ فَاطِرِ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ جَاعِلِ الۡمَلٰٓـئِكَةِ رُسُلًا اُولِىۡۤ اَجۡنِحَةٍ مَّثۡنٰى وَثُلٰثَ وَرُبٰعَ ؕ يَزِيۡدُ فِى الۡخَـلۡقِ مَا يَشَآءُ ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌ

translation.text: All praise be to Allah, the Fashioner of the heavens and earth, Who appointed angels as His message bearers, having two, three, four wings. He adds to His creation whatever He pleases. Verily Allah has power over everything.

commentary.text: The Power of Allah SWT

This Surah begins with اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ (Alhamdulillah). The Arabic word "Hamd" is used both for praise and for gratitude. Allah SWT alone is worthy of All praise and All thanks. All praise and gratitude 'Hamd' belong only to Allah SWT who is the sole creator of the heavens and the earth.
The status of angels is being clarified here whom the mushirks had made their gods and goddesses. Angels are no more than obedient servants of Allah SWT.
(1) Angels perform the service of communicating messages between Allah SWT and His Prophets.
(2) The duty of these angels to execute the commands of Allah Almighty throughout the universe.

The mention of two and three and four pairs of the wings shows that different angels have been granted different degrees of powers by Allah SWT. They have been equipped with different powers of speed and efficiency as demanded by the nature of service for which they are employed.

translation.text: Whatever Mercy Allah accords to people, none can withhold; and whatever He withholds, no other will be able to release after Him. He is Most Mighty, Most Wise.

commentary.text: None can withhold the Mercy of Allah SWT
Allah SWT tells us that what He wills happens, and what He does not will does not happen. None can give what He withholds and none can withhold what He gives. Allah' SWTs decree is final.

This is meant to remove the misunderstanding of the mushriks who believed that some servants of Allah SWT had powers to provide them provision, children, health etc. All these superstitions of shirk are baseless and the pure truth is that whatever of mercy reaches people reaches them only through Allah SWT's bounty and grace.

This theme of shirk has been expressed many places in the Quran and the hadith in different ways so that man may avoid the humiliation of begging at every door and at every shrine and realize that making or marring of his destiny is in the power of One Allah SWT alone and none else.

translation.text: Surely Satan is an enemy to you. Therefore, do take him as an enemy. He calls his followers to his way so that they may be among the inmates of the Fire.

commentary.text: Allah SWT very clearly tell us that: “Satan is your enemy!” So, treat satan the way you would treat an enemy – beware and be on guard. Do not befriend or succumb to the thoughts or suggestions that satan puts in our hearts and minds. Satan (i) invites people to shirk (ii) casts doubts in people’s hearts regarding Iman thus prevents us from obedience (iii) provokes people to sin by making evil deeds look beautiful/good (iv) creates disputes in homes.

Satan lulls us into a false sense of complacency into believing that Allah SWT is most forgiving and most merciful so do what you want to do (sins.) However, it is essential for us to recognize wrong as wrong and not just follow desires i.e. whether it is being overly extravagant or even excessive sleeping. Best protection again satan is knowledge.
FYI – When a baby is born satan pokes it. That is why we must read the azan in a baby's ear right at the time of birth.

translation.text: A severe chastisement lies in store for those that disbelieve, but there is pardon and a great reward for those that believe and work righteous deeds.

commentary.text: FORMULA FOR FAILURE AND SUCCESS
Disbelief = Severe punishment (Failure) AND Iman + Good deeds = Success

sections.title: 8-9 THAT PERSON WHO CONSIDER HIS EVIL DEEDS TO BE GOOD CANNOT BE GUIDED TO THE RIGHT PATH

translation.text: Are those whose evil-doing is made so appealing to them that they deem it good ˹like those who are rightly guided?  It is˺ certainly Allah ˹Who leaves to stray whoever He wills, and guides whoever He wills. So do not grieve yourself to death over them ˹O Prophet˺. Surely Allah is All-Knowing of what they do.

commentary.text: Context: Ayats 3-7 were addressed to the common people. Now mention has been made of the standard bearers of error and deviation, who were exerting their utmost to frustrate and defeat the mission of the Prophet (PBUH). The Chiefs of Makkah are being addressed here as they were employing every falsehood, fraud and trick to defeat the mission of the Prophet (PBUH). These people were, in fact, not involved in any misunderstanding about the Prophet (PBUH). They knew well what he was calling them to was the truth and the evils and moral weaknesses that they themselves were striving to maintain.

A person who commits evil but knows and understands that he is committing evil.  Then such a person can be reformed by counsel and advice, and sometimes his own conscience also pricks and brings him to the right path, this is because his habits are perverted, but not his mind.

But there is another kind of a person whose mentality has been perverted who has lost the ability to discriminate between good and evil, for whom the life of sin has become alluring and lustrous. Such a person is not amenable to any advice and any admonition. It is useless to waste one's time and energy for the reformation of such a person.
The inviter to truth should turn his attention towards those whose consciences is still alive and who may still be inclined to listen to the truth.

The insertion of the words “Then indeed, Allah sends astray whom He wills, and guides whom He wills,” gives the meaning that Allah SWT deprives the grace of guidance to those who become so perverted mentally, thus leaves them to wander aimlessly in the ways in which they themselves wish to remain lost.

After making the Prophet (PBUH) realize this fact Allah SWT urges him to the effect: 'It is not within your power to bring such people to the right path; therefore, have patience in their regard. Just as Allah is indifferent about them, so should you also avoid being unduly anxious about their reformation'.

Lesson: These days movies, TV, society as a whole portrays evil or indecency in such a positive light and it seems attractive and normal. Beware and be aware of who and what you idealize or hold in high esteem.

Lesson: Allah SWT gives a person whatever they are striving for – if it is the world then a person will get the world (or some part of it) if a person is striving for the Hereafter, then in sha Allah, he/she will be duly guided. So live life fully alert and conscious and not a life of thoughtlessness/heedlessness (like an animal).

translation.text: It is Allah Who sends forth winds which then set the clouds in motion, which We drive to some dead land giving a fresh life to earth after it had become dead. Such will be the resurrection of the dead.

commentary.text: The Chiefs of Makkah believed that the Hereafter is an impossibility and will never happen. That is why they are living under the delusion that they may do whatever they like in this world and the time will never come when they will have to appear before their God and render an account of their deeds.

On the Day of Resurrection, the dead men of all ages, will suddenly rise back to life on one call of Allah SWT, just as the dead earth comes back to life with one shower of the rain and the roots lying dead for ages become green and start sprouting up from the layers of the earth.

sections.title: 10-11 LET ALL THOSE WHO ARE SEEKING HONOR KNOW THAT REAL HONOR IS IN THE OBEDIENCE OF ALLAH

arabic_lines: مَنۡ كَانَ يُرِيۡدُ الۡعِزَّةَ فَلِلّٰهِ الۡعِزَّةُ جَمِيۡعًا ؕ اِلَيۡهِ يَصۡعَدُ الۡـكَلِمُ الطَّيِّبُ وَالۡعَمَلُ الصَّالِحُ يَرۡفَعُهٗ ؕ وَ الَّذِيۡنَ يَمۡكُرُوۡنَ السَّيِّاٰتِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ شَدِيۡدٌ  ؕ وَمَكۡرُ اُولٰٓـئِكَ هُوَ يَبُوۡرُ

translation.text: He who seeks glory, let him know that all glory belongs to Allah alone. To Him do good words go up, and righteous action uplifts them. But those who contrive evil deeds, a severe punishment lies in store for them, and their contriving will come to naught.

commentary.text: Honor, Power and Glory in this World and in the Hereafter comes by obeying Allah

Context: It should be noted that whatever the Chiefs of Makkah (the Quraysh) were doing against the Prophet (PBUH) they were doing for the sake of their glory and honor. They thought that if the Prophet (PBUH) succeeded in his mission their influence and power would fade away and their honor among the Arabs would be ruined.

Thus, here Allah SWT warns that the honor you have attained via your disbelief and rebellion against Allah SWT is a false honor destined to be ruined. The only real and enduring honor is attained through the service of Allah SWT. If you turn sincerely and faithfully to Him then you will attain it. And if you turn away from Him then you are bound to live a hopeless and wretched life.
DEFINITION OF SUCCESS
Thus, here is the explanation for the oft repeated formula for success. Iman + good deeds = success.

Good words ascend to Allah SWT and righteous deeds raise good words. The Quran presents the righteous word and the righteous action as interdependent or interlinked. Mere lip service does not exalt a word, the power of the righteous action is needed to exalt and raise it high. That is why after doing a good deed i.e reading the Quran, feeding the poor etc., one should make dua (as the acceptance rate is very high).
Hadith:
When the Muslim servants says….
Subhan Allah (سبحان الله): Meaning Allah SWT is perfect in an absolute sense without any defects or imperfections of any kind. Usually translated as Glory be to Allah SWT.

Alhamdulillah (الحمد لله): Meaning all praise and thanks belong to Allah SWT alone because He is the originator of everything. To praise or thank something is indirectly praising and thanking Allah because He is its true Creator. Usually translated as Praise be to Allah SWT.
Allahu Akbar (الله أكبر): Meaning Allah SWT is greater than everything else not just in your life but the entire existence. Usually translated as Allah SWT is Great.
La ilaaha illa Allah (لا إله إلا الله): There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah SWT alone without any partners in any way or form. Usually translated as There is no god except Allah SWT.

…Then an angel takes these words and puts them under his wing then ascends with them to the heaven. He does not take them past any group of angels but they seek forgiveness for the one who said them until he brings them before Allah SWT, may He be glorified.
After namaz one should recite: (i) Subhan Allah  (سبحان الله): 33 (ii) Alhamdulillah (الحمد لله) 33 (iii) Allahu Akbar (الله أكبر) 34
Prophet (PBUH) said pray 4 rakat namaz before zuhur as at that time the gates of the sky are open.
Doing tasbeeh, especially during the AM and PM, is highly recommended.

translation.text: Allah created you from dust, then from a drop of sperm, then He made you into pairs. No female conceives, nor delivers (a child) except with His knowledge. None is given a long life nor is any diminished in his life but it is written in a Book. Surely that is quite easy for Allah.

commentary.text: (Also see 35:2 regarding Allah's decree)

From here again the discourse is directed to the common people. Mankind, in the first instance, was created from dust directly. Then his race was perpetuated through the sperm-drop. Thus, man is told to understand his origins – and do not get arrogant.

It is pre-ordained for everyone who is born in this world how long he/she will live. If a person lives a long life, he/she does so by Allah SWT’s decree, and if another one lives a short life, he too lives so by Allah SWT’s decree. Whatever happens is by Allah SWT will or permission – this is the Divine Decree.

sections.title: 12-14 ALLAH HAS CREATED WATER, DAY, NIGHT, SUN AND MOON FOR MAN'S BENEFIT AND DEITIES BESIDES ALLAH CAN NEITHER HEAR, NOR RESPONSE NOR YET OWN EVEN A THREAD OF A DATE-STONE

translation.text: The two masses of water are not alike. The one is sweet, sates thirst, and is pleasant to drink from, while the other is salt, bitter on the tongue. Yet from both you eat fresh meat, and extract from it ornaments that you wear; and you see ships cruising through it that you may seek of His Bounty and be thankful to Him.

commentary.text: The Blessings and Signs of Allah SWT

That God wanted water to be of different types is clear. That such variety serves a definite yet varied purpose is also clear. The sweet, palatable water serves to provide, among other things, drinking water and thus is indeed essential for life.  As for the other type of water, which is bitter and salty, filling seas and oceans, famous scientists explain that it is essential for keeping the ecosystem in harmony.

Scientists speculate that, 'In spite of all the gaseous and mostly poisonous emanations from the earth, the atmosphere remains practically uncontaminated and unchanged -- which is necessary to man’s existence'. Oceans play a part in maintaining this balance.

The reference to the difference in the two great bodies of water suggests that, like every other variation, it is done deliberately. The two different bodies of water are shown as united in being subjugated to man: “Yet from each you eat fresh meat and extract ornaments to wear.

Ships plough through rivers and seas, benefiting man via trade/travel/food etc. The density of the water coupled with materials used in shipbuilding help keep ships float and moving. Other factors include, the wind and or electric and steam power. All these elements are united in being subjugated to man’s will by the grace of Allah SWT.

The purpose behind the diversity of creation is to achieve harmony and balance, which allows the overall system of the universe to function. (This is all for man's benefit.) Only the Creator of the universe and everything that lives in it can only do this. Such a meticulously accurate system cannot come about by sheer coincidence.
So reflect and ponder upon Allah SWT's creation so that you may give thanks to your Lord.

translation.text: He causes the night to phase into the day and the day into the night, and He has subjected the sun and the moon, each running its course to an appointed term.  That is Allah, your Lord; to Him belongs the Kingdom; but those whom you call upon, apart from Allah, possess not so much as the skin of a date-stone. ( قِطْمِيٍ (Qitmir)

commentary.text: Allah SWT causes the night to enter into day and day to enter night in a seamless and majestic manner – without any delays or hiccups. They appear and disappear, rise and set before everyone. That is, the light of the day starts diminishing and the darkness of the night increases gradually so as to cover up everything completely. Likewise, towards the end of the night, in the beginning, a streak of the light appears on the horizon, and then the bright day dawns. They serve as signs for all generations to contemplate. And thus, everything is moving along till that one final day.
"That is Allah, your Lord; to Him belongs the Kingdom";
THIS IS YOUR RAAB! BY WHOSE GRACE AND MERCY, THE ENTIRE UNIVERSE HAS BEEN SUBJUGATED FOR THE BENEFIT OF MAN. So be grateful, worship your Lord and do not ascribe partners to Him.

The word 'qitmir', means the thin skin that covers the date stone of the date fruit, in other words, the gods of the mushriks do not possess anything in the heavens or on earth, not even close to a qitmir.

sections.title: 15-18 MANKIND IS IN NEED OF ALLAH, WHILE HE IS NOT IN NEED OF ANY ONE

arabic_lines: يٰۤاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اَنۡتُمُ الۡفُقَرَآءُ اِلَى اللّٰهِۚ وَاللّٰهُ هُوَ الۡغَنِىُّ الۡحَمِيۡدُ

translation.text: O people, it is you who stand in need of Allah;  as for Allah, He is Self-Sufficient, Immensely Praiseworthy.

commentary.text: One should not remain under the delusion that Allah SWT needs our help or that if we do not accept Him as God, He will incur some loss. The fact is that we are entirely and desperately dependent upon Allah SWT. We cannot remain alive even for a moment if He does not keep us alive. Allah SWT is free of all needs while we are nothing but needy of Allah SWT.

Therefore, when we are told to adopt His obedience, it is not because Allah SWT stands in need of it but because our very own success is dependent upon it – in this world as well as in the Hereafter. If we disbelieve, we do so at the cost of only/solely harming ourselves and not Allah SWT (in any way).

People need to be reminded of this so that they do not give themselves airs. What man receives of God’s grace is amazing, considering how small, ignorant and weak man is. Allah SWT creates man, puts him in charge of the earth, equips him with all he needs to discharge his task. Yet, we go astray and become arrogant to the extent that we start denying our Lord. Nevertheless, Allah SWT sends one messenger after another, giving us books of guidance as well as showing us miracles. It is all part of His essential attributes to give in abundance and without reckoning. The recipients, mere humans, do not contribute anything to God’s kingdom by following His guidance, nor do they decrease it in any way when they turn blindly away from it. They are not irreplaceable.

The word "Ghani," الۡغَنِىُّ implies that He is the Owner of everything: He is Self-sufficient and Independent of all. The word "Hamid," الۡحَمِيۡدُ implies Allah SWT alone is worthy of 'hamd' that is ALL praise and all gratitude.
GOD IS INDEED FREE OF ALL WANTS AND WORTHY OF ALL PRAISE AND THANKS.
اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ (Alhamdulillah).

sections.title: 19-26 LIVING AND DEAD ARE NOT ALIKE YOU CANNOT MAKE THOSE WHO ARE BURIED IN THE GRAVE HEAR YOU

translation.text: The blind and the seeing are not alike,
nor darkness and light;
nor cool shade and torrid heat;
nor are the living and the dead alike. Allah makes to hear whomsoever He wishes, but you, (O Prophet), cannot cause to hear those who are in their graves.

commentary.text: The Believer and the Disbeliever are not equal

Here a believer and a disbeliever have been contrasted. The believer and the disbeliever are not equal. The difference between following divine guidance and the nature of going astray is as profound as the difference between blindness and sight, light and darkness, coolness and scorching heat, life and death.
Allah SWT likens the believers to the living and the disbelievers to the dead.

A believer's eyes are open and can appreciate how this universe and creation itself bears evidence to the majesty of Allah SWT and understands that man’s answerability before Allah SWT is around the corner. Conversely, a disbeliever wanders blindly in the superstitions of ignorance and darkness of doubt, presumptions and speculations, not inclined towards Iman.
Thus, the notions that the two will ultimately meet the same end, is utterly false.

The believer has been likened to the living and the disbeliever to the dead. That is, the believer's feelings, understandings and perceptions are alive and the conscience awake --thus making him aware of the distinction between the good and the evil every moment. Contrary to this, the person who is wholly lost in disbelief is like a dead person who has no sense or feeling left, thus even worse than the blind person who is wandering about in darkness.

The powers of Allah SWT are unlimited. But it is not within the power of the Messenger to make those people hear/understand whose consciences are dead and whose ears deaf to every call to the truth. He can only make those people to hear him, who are inclined towards the truth and iman.
Lesson: Make dua to Allah SWT for guidance (particularly when/if we feel lost or have low faith).

sections.title: 27-37 THOSE WHO RECITE AL-QURAN, ESTABLISH SALAH AND GIVE CHARITY MAY HOPE FOR ALLAH'S BLESSINGS AND REWARDS AND THOSE WHO DISBELIEVE SHALL HAVE A PAINFUL PUNISHMENT IN THE HELL-FIRE FOREVER

translation.text: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky with which We bring forth fruits of different colours? And in the mountains are streaks of varying shades of white, red, and raven black;

just as people, living beings, and cattle are of various colours as well. Of all of Allah’s servants, only the knowledgeable ˹of His might˺ are ˹truly˺ in awe of Him. Allah is indeed Almighty, All-Forgiving.

commentary.text: Nowhere in this universe – created by Allah SWT – do we find homogeneity and uniformity. Variety is everywhere, so much so that even two pieces of fruit, from the same tree are not of the same color, size or taste. ONYLY upon reflection of the universe do we understand the splendor of Allah SWT and His creation. It is truly humbling!

Knowledge inspires within us an unparalleled love and awe for our Raab and the more we fear His disobedience. Conversely, the more a person is unaware of the attributes of Allah SWT the more he will be fearless of Him.
Hadith regarding the Merits of the Scholars
Whoever follows a path to seek knowledge Allah SWT will show him the way to Paradise.
The angels lower their wings being pleased with the one who seeks knowledge. Whoever is in the heavens and on earth, even the fish in the sea, ask for forgiveness for the scholar.

The superiority of the scholar over the worshipper is like that of the moon over all other heavenly bodies. The scholars are the heirs of the Prophets, for the Prophets did not leave behind Dinars and Dirhams, but they left behind knowledge; and whoever receives it, receives an abundance of good fortune.

Lesson: Reflect and ponder upon the signs of Allah SWT, His wisdom, His greatness, His universe. Seek knowledge for yourself so that you become unshakeable in your Iman. Make deen a priority, just like you make your studies, job, and house etc. a priority. In fact, make deen your TOP PRIORITY.

translation.text: Surely those who recite the Book of Allah and establish Prayer and spend, privately and publicly, out of what We have provided them, look forward to a trade that shall suffer no loss

commentary.text: Allah SWT tells us that His believing servants are those who: (i) recite and believe in His Book (Quran) and (ii) perform the prescribed deeds mentioned in the Quran, such as, establish regular prayer (iii) spend (in charity) out of that which Allah SWT has provided for them, both secretly and openly.

translation.text: (a trade in which they have invested their all) so that Allah may pay them their wages in full and may add to them out of His Bounty. He is Most Forgiving, Most Appreciative.

commentary.text: This conduct/behavior of the believer has been likened to a trade because in trade a man invests his money, labor and capabilities in the hopes that he will not only get his capital back but in addition some profit as well.

Likewise, a believer also invests his time, energies, capabilities and wealth in carrying out Allah SWT's commands in the hope that he will not only get his full reward but that Allah SWT will bless him with much more from His bounty as well.

In worldly trade/ bargains there is the risk of loss along with the hope of profits. Contrary to this, in the bargain that a sincere servant makes with his Raab there is no risk of any loss whatsoever. It’s a WIN/WIN.

Allah SWT’s relation with the sincere believers is not that of a miserly master who checks his servant on trivialities and brings all his services and loyalties into account. Rather, Allah SWT is the Most Beneficent and Generous Master. He overlooks the errors of His obedient servant and is Most appreciative. (What an honor for man that Allah SWT appreciates his/her good deeds).
Note: The Quran uses words and examples/parables that resonate with the common man.

translation.text: Then We granted the Book to those We have chosen from Our servants. Some of them wrong themselves, some follow a middle course, and some are foremost in good deeds by Allah’s Will. That is ˹truly˺ the greatest bounty.

commentary.text: The Quran in an inheritance for Allah SWT’s chosen servants. Inheritance means that it must be passed onto future generations – this is the right of inheritance.

There are three types of people who are inheritors of the Book. (i) Those who are given the Quran yet they do not learn it or recognize its importance. They have wronged themselves. (ii) Those who are average or moderate in their deen (iii) Those who exceed in good deeds (by the permission of Allah SWT). Such have attained true success.
DEFINITION OF SUCCESS
Race towards and exceed/surpass in doing good deeds = success

translation.text: They will enter the Gardens of Eternity, where they will be adorned with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their clothing will be silk.

commentary.text: Those who exceed in good deeds their reward is paradise (in sha Allah).

translation.text: As for those who disbelieved, the Fire of Hell awaits them. There they shall not be finished off and die; nor will the torment (of Hell) be lightened for them. Thus do We requite every thankless being.

They will cry out in Hell and say: “Our Lord, let us out so that we may act righteously, different from what we did before.” (They will be told): “Did we not grant you an age long enough for anyone to take heed if he had wanted to take heed? Besides, there came a warner to you. So have a taste of the torment now. None may come to the help of the wrong-doers.”

commentary.text: Lesson: Punishment of Hell should not be taken lightly as the anguish, pain, humiliation and torment will be beyond our imagination.

Hadith:  Man gets more and more opportunities for choosing and adopting the right path, his responsibility also will increase accordingly; so much so that the one who does not adopt right guidance even in old age will have no chance left for making any excuse. This same thing has been reported by Abu Hurairah and Sahl bin Saad as-Saidi in a Hadith, saying: The one who lives a short life has an excuse to offer, but there is no room for making an excuse for him who lives for 60 years or more.” (Bukhari Ahmad, Nasai, Ibn Jarir, Ibn Abi Hatim).

sections.title: 38-41 ALLAH HAS NOT SENT ANY BOOK WHICH HAS A PROVISION OF SHIRK (WORSHIPPING ANY ONE ELSE BESIDES ALLAH)

translation.text: Say to them (O Prophet): “Have you ever seen those of your associates upon whom you call apart from Allah? Show me what have they created in the earth? Or do they have any partnership (with Allah) in the heavens? Or have We given them a Book so that they have a clear proof (for associating others with Allah in His Divinity)?”Nay, what these wrong-doers promise each other is nothing but delusion.

commentary.text: The argument is strong and the evidence is clear. This earth is stretched before us – then which part of the earth or which creature on this earth can anyone claim to have created other than Allah SWT.
“Associates of yours,” means those false gods or deities are not in fact the associates of Allah SWT but the ones whom the mushriks themselves have made associates of Allah SWT.

Allah SWT asks if these false deities possess a written sanction or some form of consent from Him in which Allah SWT has given them the powers to heal the sick, provide jobs for the jobless, fulfill needs of the needy, or that Allah SWT has made them His representative so that people can pray to them and present gifts/offerings.
If you possess any such sanction then produce it. And if you have no such sanction then you should consider on what grounds you have invented these false creeds and practices/concepts.

sections.title: 42-45 PLOTTING EVIL RECOIL NONE BUT THE AUTHOR OF IT AND IF ALLAH WAS TO PUNISH PEOPLE FOR THEIR WRONG DOINGS, HE WOULD HAVE NOT LEFT EVEN AND ANIMAL AROUND

arabic_lines: وَلَوۡ يُـؤَاخِذُ اللّٰهُ النَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُوۡا مَا تَرَكَ عَلٰى ظَهۡرِهَا مِنۡ دَآ بَّةٍ وَّلٰـكِنۡ يُّؤَخِّرُهُمۡ اِلٰٓى اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّىۚ فَاِذَا جَآءَ اَجَلُهُمۡ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهٖ بَصِيۡرًا

translation.text: If Allah were to take people to task for their deeds, He would not leave any living creature on earth, but He grants them respite to an appointed time. When their appointed time comes to an end, surely Allah fully observes His servants.

commentary.text: The Wisdom behind delaying the Punishment

The last Ayat states Allah SWT's restraint/patience and compassion, juxtaposed with His power and knowledge. People are given a chance and not punished immediately as an aspect of His grace. If Allah SWT were to punish people [at once] for the wrongs they do, He would not leave a single living creature on the surface of the earth. However, He grants man respite for a term set [by Him].
Allah SWT knows and sees his servant like no other. The time of change and repent is now!

items.text: ALLAH SWT VERY CLEARLY TELL US THAT: “SATAN IS YOUR ENEMY!”
(35:6) Surely Satan is an enemy to you. Therefore, do take him as an enemy. He calls his followers to his way so that they may be among the inmates of the Fire.
Treat satan the way you would treat an enemy – beware and be on guard.
FORMULA FOR FAILURE AND SUCCESS
(35:7) A severe chastisement lies in store for those that disbelieve, but there is pardon and a great reward for those that believe and work righteous deeds.
Disbelief = Severe punishment (Failure) AND Iman + Good deeds = Success
THIS IS YOUR RAAB! BY WHOSE GRACE AND MERCY, THE ENTIRE UNIVERSE HAS BEEN SUBJUGATED FOR THE BENEFIT OF MAN.

(35:13) He causes the night to phase into the day and the day into the night, and He has subjected the sun and the moon, each running its course to an appointed term.  That is Allah, your Lord; to Him belongs the Kingdom; but those whom you call upon, apart from Allah, possess not so much as the skin of a date-stone. ( قِطْمِيٍ (Qitmir)
So be grateful, worship your Lord and do not ascribe partners to Him. Recognize your Raab by pondering over the universe and the signs/miracles within it. Evidence of tawhid is all around us.
Gain Knowledge as knowledge humbles a person into recognizing his/her insignificance and the magnificence of our Raab.
GOD IS INDEED FREE OF ALL WANTS AND WORTHY OF ALL PRAISE AND THANKS.
اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ (Alhamdulillah).
(35:15) O people, it is you who stand in need of Allah;  as for Allah, He is Self-Sufficient, Immensely Praiseworthy.
We are entirely and fully dependent on Allah SWT. It is only in our best interest that we should accept Him as our Raab, that is, submit fully and wholeheartedly.
DEFINITION OF SUCCESS
(35:7) A severe chastisement lies in store for those that disbelieve, but there is pardon and a great reward for those that believe and work righteous deeds.
FORMULA FOR FAILURE AND SUCCESS
Disbelief = Severe punishment (Failure) AND Iman + Good deeds = Success

(35:10) He who seeks glory, let him know that all glory belongs to Allah alone. To Him do good words go up, and righteous action uplifts them. But those who contrive evil deeds, a severe punishment lies in store for them, and their contriving will come to naught.
Thus, here is the explanation for the oft repeated formula for success. Iman + good deeds = success.

(35:32) Then We granted the Book to those We have chosen from Our servants. Some of them wrong themselves, some follow a middle course, and some are foremost in good deeds by Allah’s Will. That is ˹truly˺ the greatest bounty.
Race towards and exceed/surpass in doing good deeds = Success

items.text: يٰسٓ ۚ

front_matter.label: Period of Revelation
front_matter.text: This is a Makki Surah revealed sometime during the middle Makkan period.  It has 83 Ayats in 5 Rukus.

front_matter.label: Subject Matter and Theme
front_matter.text:
This Surah shares the same main themes of all Makkan Surahs: (i) Tauhid (ii) Belief in the DoJ and (iii) Prophethood. These fundamental issues of faith, although oft repeatedly, are tackled from different angles/perspectives as per the theme/requirement of each Surah.
This Makkan Surah is characterized by short Ayats and a fast rhythm. The Holy Prophet said: "Recite Surah Ya Sin to the dying ones among you." The issue that is most strongly emphasized in the Surah is that of Resurrection.

sections.title: 1-12 AL-QURAN IS REVEALED BY THE ALLAH TO WARN PEOPLE AND PROPHET IS TOLD THAT HE COULD WARN ONLY THOSE PEOPLE WHO HAVE THE FEAR OF ALLAH

translation.text: Ya'. Sin
By the Wise Qur'an

commentary.text: (Ayat 1-2) Allah SWT takes an oath by these two letters (Ya'. Sin)) and by the Quran.  As He swears by the Qurān, Allah SWT describes it as being full of wisdom.

translation.text: You ˹O Prophet˺ are truly one of the messengers

commentary.text: Allah SWT at the very beginning of the discourse has said: You are indeed one of the Messengers, which implies that the people who deny your Prophethood are misled and mistaken.

translation.text: (and this Quran) is a revelation from the Most Mighty, the Most Compassionate

commentary.text: Here, two of the attributes of the Sender of the Quran have been mentioned.

First, that Allah SWT is the 'Most Mighty,' meaning that the message of the Quran is not a counsel that you can overlook or ignore. It is a message from the Owner of the Universe, so pay close attention!

The second attribute of Allah SWT is the 'Most Compassionate or Merciful', which is meant to make one realize that it is all due to His kindness and mercy that He has sent His Messenger for our guidance/ instruction and sent down the Quran so that you may avoid errors and follow the right path leading, in sha Allah, to the successes in this world and the Next.

translation.text: and We have put a barrier before them and a barrier behind them, and have covered them up, so they are unable to see.

commentary.text: The State of Those Who are decreed to be among the Doomed

There are signs in front of them or before their very eyes (meaning Allah SWT's creation) and signs behind them (meaning the stories of past nations to take a lesson from) but they cannot take heed. These Ayat’s describe the arrogant and heedless nature of the disbeliever, that is, no matter how clear the signs are they refuse to believe because Allah SWT has placed a barrier between them and guidance.

translation.text: You can warn only him who follows the Admonition and fears the Merciful Lord without seeing Him. Give such a one good tidings of forgiveness and a generous reward.

commentary.text: Those who obey and worship, realizing that Allah SWT is aware of all that they do (despite not being able to see Allah SWT) -- these are people who benefit from warning.

For such people there will be forgiveness and a generous reward. Fearing Allah SWT and following what He has revealed are two aspects of faith that go hand in hand: (i) when a person truly fears Allah SWT, (ii) then he/she is certain to follow His guidance.

translation.text: We shall surely raise the dead to life and We record what they did and the traces of their deeds that they have left behind. We have encompassed that in a Clear Book.

commentary.text: Three kinds of the entries are made in the conduct-book of men.
First, whatever a person does, good or bad is entered in the divine register. (Actions)
Second, whatever impressions a person makes upon those around him/her via ideas, intentions, aims and objectives etc.

Third, whatever influences he/she has left behind for future generations, on society and on mankind as a whole, will go on being recorded in his/her account as far as they reach and as long as they remain active and operative. For example, the good and bad training given by him/her to children, the good or evil that he/she has spread in the society, and its impact on mankind as a whole, will go on being maintained till the time that it goes on producing good or evil results in the world.
Thus everything is recorded in a clear, detailed and meticulous manner. Everything I am doing right now is being recorded in Allah SWT's register.

This is a threat for the heedless that there will be written/recorded proof and good news for those who do good deeds. Whoever starts something good and others follow then he/she will get the reward for the trend they started. Similarly with an evil trend started. We are responsible for our own legacy – good/bad.
Death stops everything except three things:
Beneficial knowledge that is passed on i.e. how to recite the Quran etc.
A righteous child who prays for his/her parents.
On-going charity i.e tree planation or building a well, etc.
Lesson: What imprint are you leaving behind?

sections.title: 13-21 AND EXAMPLE OF THREE PROPHETS WHO WERE SENT TO ONE TOWN, ALL DENIED THEM EXCEPT ONE MAN WHO CAME FROM CROSS THE TOWN

translation.text: Recite to them, as a case in point, the story of the people of the town when the Messengers came to them.

commentary.text: The Story of the Dwellers of the Town and Their Messengers, a Lesson that Those Who denied Their Messengers were Destroyed
Commentators have expressed the opinion that this town is the Syrian city of Antioch, however, this has neither been clearly determined in the Quran nor in any authentic Hadith.

To understand the purpose for which the Quran is narrating this story it is not necessary to know the name of the town and the messengers. The object is to warn the Quraysh, as if to say: You are following the same path of stubbornness, prejudice and denial of the truth as had been followed by the people of that habitation and are preparing yourselves to meet the same doom as was met by them.

translation.text: We sent to them two Messengers and they rejected both of them as liars. Then We strengthened them with a third (Messenger).
They said: “We have been sent to you as Messengers.” The people of the town said: “You are only human beings like ourselves, and the Merciful Lord has revealed nothing. You are simply lying.”

commentary.text: The disbelievers said: 'Since you are human beings, you cannot be the messengers of God'.  A similar view was expressed by the disbelievers of Makkah who said that, 'Muhammad (PBUH) cannot be a Messenger of Allah SWT because he is a man (human). This denial is due to pride.

translation.text: The Messengers said: “Our Lord knows that we have indeed been sent to you
and our duty is no more than to clearly convey the Message.”

commentary.text: The Prophets response:  Our duty is only to convey to you the message that Allah SWT has entrusted us with. Then it is for you to accept it or reject it. We have not been made responsible to make you accept it forcibly. And if you do not accept it, we shall not be seized in consequence of your disbelief. You, yourselves, will be answerable for your crimes.

translation.text: The people of the town said: “We believe you are an evil omen for us. If you do not desist, we will stone you or you will receive a grievous chastisement from us.”

commentary.text: What they (people of the town) meant was that: ‘You (Prophet/s) are an evil omen for us. Our gods/deities have become angry with us on account of what you have been saying against them. Now whatever calamity is befalling us is only because of you'.
This is precisely the same reasoning expressed by the disbelievers and the hypocrites of Arabia concerning the Prophet (PBUH):
If they suffered a loss, they said:
This is because of you (Prophet (PBUH)'. (Surah An-Nisa, Ayat 77).
The people of Thamud said to their Prophet:
We regard you and your companions as a sign of bad omen. (Surah An-Naml, Ayat 47).

translation.text: The Messengers replied: “Your evil omen is with you. (Are you saying this) because you were asked to take heed? The truth is that you are a people who have exceeded all bounds.”

commentary.text: No one is an evil omen for another.  Instead of distinguishing truth from falsehood by means of a solid argument, the disbelievers were making these false claims on account of their superstitious whims. The disbelievers did not like to be warned as they felt restricted from freely doing what they wanted.

translation.text: In the meantime a man came running from the far end of the town, saying: “My people, follow the Messengers;

commentary.text: A man from the same town came running towards the people imploring the townspeople to follow the messengers who are not asking for any compensation and leading you to the truth.

translation.text: follow those who do not ask any recompense from you and are rightly-guided.

commentary.text: Two signs of sincerity:
(i) Does not ask for compensation or reward (material)
(ii) What he/she is saying makes sense.
Golden rule: Give more that you take!
